bio: Here, owner-chef Alberte Gutiérrez’s aim is to offer high-quality, non-gimmicky cuisine based around the very best Galician meat and vegetables but with a special focus on the incredible fish and seafood from the Rías Baixas region (spider crab, lobster, langoustine, shrimp from local estuaries, wild bream etc), almost all of which are sourced from the fish auction in A Guarda. The seasonal à la carte shows a penchant for dishes cooked on the open grill, alongside interesting daily specials and two tasting menus (Esencia and Alberte)....
